news.title: OpenAI says its models helped redesign AMD chip circuitry
news.summary: Reported: OpenAI claims its models found circuit changes giving up to 14% performance gains, some already in a design sent for manufacturing. All figures are OpenAI's; AMD has not published its own.

news.title: Signal blocks screenshots by default because on-device AI agents can read the screen
news.summary: Reported: Signal now blocks screenshots by default on Android and iOS, citing AI agents built into phones that read on-screen content. A concrete example of agent privacy and security trade-offs.

news.title: Meta re-evaluates its 2030 net-zero goal after a 45% emissions jump from AI build-out
news.summary: Reported: Meta's emissions rose 45% last year on data-centre expansion for AI; the company is reconsidering its net-zero target.

news.title: Runway turns a 27B video model into an open-weight robot controller
news.summary: Reported: a video world model repurposed as an action model for robots, released with open weights. Relevant to vision-language-action models and world models.
